details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:78,473-508 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: On the cut-off (truncated) runs-list path, the first list read and the window read have already used 2 reads, so a failed or timed_out run on a descendant commit (need=2: compare plus jobs) fails the check `[ $((reads + need)) -gt "${MAX_READS_PER_HEAL}" ]` (2+2=4 > 3) and logs `outcome=pending reason=read_budget` before compare is called.
  WHY: Every hourly tick parks the heal the same way, so the "## Fix did not hold" reopen never happens before the heal leaves the 7-day window. All reviewers rate this MAJOR. sonnet and minimax say the read_limit fix described in PR comment entry[3] is not in the script on disk. glm says gemini's line 489 citation is stale and that the plan (docs/plans/heal-evidence-reproduction-and-trends-plan.md:373) and agents.d/heal-verify.md count the window read inside the 3 reads. test_truncated_runs_list_reads_the_first_day_after_the_merge uses only MERGE_SHA runs, so it does not cover this path.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:484-493,535-548 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The window read (created=<mergedAt>..<mergedAt+1d>) writes `> "${runs_file}"` over the first page, and the selection jq reads only `${runs_file}`, so decisive later runs from the first page are thrown away.
  WHY: If the first day after the merge has no decisive run, picked_id stays empty and every tick logs `outcome=pending reason=no_completed_run`, which is misleading because completed runs exist. The heal is never verified before it leaves the 7-day window. All reviewers rate this MAJOR. minimax says the PR comment entry[3] remedy (`runs_<n>_window.json` and joining the two lists) is not on disk.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:464-487 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A failed window read (line 486) logs `outcome=error issue=${number} reason=runs_failed`, the same reason as a failed first runs-list read (line 466), so the two failure points look the same in the logs.
  WHY: Operators cannot tell which query failed on the cut-off path. All four rate this NIT. minimax adds that the agents.d fragment lists `runs_window_failed` and `window_undecided` and changelog.d/heal-verify.md describes "4 reads when a heal's runs list is cut off", none of which the script does.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_verify.py:192-197 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The `_execute` env.update dict literal sets "GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER" twice; the later None wins, so the "0" entry is dead code (pyflakes F601).
  WHY: Test behaviour is unchanged, but the dead entry misleads readers and fails linting. Both rate this NIT. minimax and glm raised the same issue only as a hardening suggestion.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:514-518 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: minimax says the selection loop mixes up a transient compare API failure with a read-budget hit, so both can log `read_budget`.
  WHY: minimax says a heal could park on a passing infrastructure error, and operators could not tell an exhausted budget from a flaky compare (NIT). sonnet and glm both checked a similar claim against the code and rejected it: lines 512-526 / line 515 log `reason=compare_failed`.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Take the oldest completed run whose head_sha "equals the merge commit or descends from it", checking descent with compare "at most 2 per heal", within "at most 3 reads per heal"; "If that run failed at the same failing step ... reopen the heal with a `## Fix did not hold` comment."
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh _verify_one, the cut-off runs-list path (lines 473-493) and the read-budget check at line 506
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: On the cut-off path a descendant-commit failure always parks as read_budget (2 list reads + compare + jobs = 4 > MAX_READS_PER_HEAL=3 at line 78), and a first day with no decisive run always parks as no_completed_run because the initial list is overwritten. The PR comment entry[3] remedy (read_limit of 4, a separate window file, the window_undecided / runs_window_failed reasons, four new tests) is not in the script or test file. No test covers a cut-off list plus a descendant failure. glm says the two constraints conflict and no code path resolves the conflict.
- requirement: Acceptance criterion "An already-verified heal is skipped." (a marker at or after the merge counts as already verified)
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh `cmd_select` in the embedded Python
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Because of the window-overwrite bug, a heal whose decisive run falls outside the first day can stay `pending reason=no_completed_run` for the whole 7-day window even though test_already_verified_heal_is_skipped passes. The window query gives no distinct log reason, so this state is not reported as a documented `runs_truncated` case.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:_verify_one: line 78 (MAX_READS_PER_HEAL=3); the cut-off window read at lines 473-489, which runs reads=$((reads + 1)) so reads=2 before the run loop; line 506 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: On the cut-off path a failure or timed_out run on a descendant commit needs 2 more reads; 2+2=4 > 3 logs "outcome=pending reason=read_budget" before compare runs. The PR comment entry[3] fix (read_limit, runs_window, window_undecided) is not on disk, and test_truncated_runs_list_reads_the_first_day_after_the_merge uses only MERGE_SHA runs.
  WHY: On busy workflows (>100 runs since the merge) the recurrence is never confirmed and "## Fix did not hold" never reopens the heal within the 7-day window.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:_verify_one: line 484 (the window read redirects > "${runs_file}", the same file that holds the first page from line 464); line 544 (the selection jq reads only "${runs_file}") | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The window read overwrites the first page; if the first day has no decisive run, picked_id stays empty and the script logs "outcome=pending reason=no_completed_run".
  WHY: The same empty one-day query repeats every tick until the heal leaves the 7-day window, and the log reason misleads operators.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:_verify_one: lines 484-487 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A failed window read logs the same reason (runs_failed) as a failed first runs-list read (lines 464-467).
  WHY: Operators are pointed at the main runs-list call, and the fragment's reason list does not separate the two.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_verify.py:_execute: line 192 ("GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER": "0",) and line 197 ("GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER": None,) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Duplicate dict key; the "0" entry is dead (pyflakes F601).
  WHY: Misleads readers, and a linter running F rules would flag the file.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: oldest completed run that "equals the merge commit or descends from it", compare "at most 2 per heal", reopen with "## Fix did not hold" | Expected change site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh, _verify_one: the cut-off runs-list path (lines 473-489) together with the read-budget check at line 506 | Evidence of absence: on the cut-off path a descendant failure always parks as read_budget and a day with no decisive run always parks as no_completed_run; the PR comment entry[3] remedy and its four new tests are absent | SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Dropped pass-1 claims (2 related items): "compare API error logged as read_budget" (wrong: lines 512-526 log reason=compare_failed); "switch-off test does not prove gh never ran" (already covered by the state["calls"] empty check).
- HARDENING (3 related items): line 484, write the window read to "${RUNTIME_DIR}/runs_${number}_window.json", add window_undecided / runs_window_failed (6-8 lines); line 506, local read_limit=MAX_READS_PER_HEAL+1 when the window read ran (3-4 lines); test line 192, delete the duplicate key (1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
